s.note: the kitchen in their little German town
s.how: Grate 800g potatoes and 1 onion, squeeze out as much liquid as you can, then mix with 2 eggs, 3 tbsp flour and 1 tsp salt. Fry heaped spoonfuls in oil for 3 minutes a side until crisp. Serve hot with 200g apple sauce and 150g sour cream.

s.n: Brown bread with butter and radishes
s.how: Slice 1 dark rye loaf thin. Spread each slice with salted butter, about 100g in total, right to the crust. Top with 1 bunch thinly sliced radishes, snipped chives and a pinch of flaky salt, then cut into fingers.

m.how: Fry 1 sliced onion in a big pot, add 500g sliced smoked sausages and brown. Add 600g diced potatoes, half a cabbage shredded, 1 tsp caraway seeds and 750ml stock. Simmer 30 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the stew is thick, then serve with crusty bread.

w.note: autumn fruit on a sheet of yeast dough
w.how: Mix 300g flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g sugar, 150ml warm milk, 1 egg and 50g soft butter into a dough and prove 1 hour. Press into a lined tray, cover with 1kg halved plums cut side up, sprinkle with 50g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon, and bake at 190C for 35 minutes.

d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Pour 150ml apple juice into each and top with 150ml sparkling water, stirring once. Serve straight away while it's still fizzing.
